lines.en: My two tails swing behind me.
I walk fast, and lightly.

lines.zh: 我从一扇门穿到另一扇。
lines.en: I pass from one door to the next.

lines.zh: 我回头，确认你还在身后。
lines.en: I glance back to make sure you are still there.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根柱子转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half a pillar.
I pull my cap low and walk on.
My heels tap out a quick rhythm.
I move faster in the shadows.
I leap down the stairs.

lines.zh: 我的手一直插在口袋里。
lines.en: My hands stay in my pockets.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根，把脚步放轻。
lines.en: I hug the baseboard and soften my steps.

lines.zh: 我两条尾巴在身后摆，走一段就听一下。
lines.en: My two tails sway behind me; I walk a stretch, then listen.
Standing, my two tails hang down.
Listening to the corridor's echoes.

lines.zh: 我的帽子遮住了半张脸。
lines.en: My cap covers half my face.
I push my hands deeper in my pockets.
I glance at the door behind me.
The light sways above me.
Counting my own steps.
Emptier here than I expected.
I let out a slow breath.

lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，等一个信号。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark, waiting for a signal.

lines.zh: 结界的边缘，我找不到路。
lines.en: At the barrier's edge I cannot find the way.

lines.zh: 身后的走廊，还是那么黑。
lines.en: The corridor behind is still that dark.
I press a hand to the door frame and listen.

lines.zh: 我又看了一眼走廊尽头。
lines.en: I glance at the corridor's far end again.
Why do you keep following me?

lines.zh: 我这个人不太信任陌生人。
lines.en: I'm not one to trust strangers.

lines.zh: 你老盯着我的尾巴做什么。
lines.en: Why do you keep staring at my tails?

lines.zh: 声音小一点，这里太空了。
lines.en: Quieter. It's too empty here.
You carry someone else's scent.
I don't mean to fight you.

lines.zh: 你知道这里发生过什么事吗？
lines.en: Do you know what happened here?
Not so loud; this floor is listening.
Stay right there. Don't come closer.
I don't need any help.
Ask what you need to. Be quick.
I have a lot still to do.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，也不认识他们。
lines.en: I don't know you, or them either.

lines.zh: 你看上去也不像是本地人。
lines.en: You don't look like a local either.
I came alone. I'll leave alone.
Don't stand in the middle of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我这两条尾巴，转得很快。
lines.en: These two tails of mine spin fast.

lines.zh: 安静一会儿，让我听清楚。
lines.en: Be quiet a moment. Let me listen.
Keep this distance from me.

lines.zh: 我不需要你替我做什么。
lines.en: I don't need you to do anything for me.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是用玩家的模型。
lines.en: My face uses the player model.
A blow lands under my ribs and I grunt.
I clamp my teeth together.
My cap's half off.
One of my tails is twisted.
Both my legs still work.
My cap is askew and I am panting hard.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴夹紧，我按住伤口。
lines.en: My two tails tuck in as I press the wound.
Don't think I'm finished.
I brace on the wall and slowly straighten.
I'm not hungry at all right now.
Half a ration is still in my pocket.
Don't let that block the way.
Got anything else up your sleeve?

lines.zh: 我两条尾巴在身后摆，食物没意思。
lines.en: Both my tails sway behind me; food does not interest me.
It's something else I need.
You're stalling for time.
Hold it. Let's talk business.
Don't put that between us.

lines.zh: 我不缺这一口，两条尾巴还摇着。
lines.en: I do not need this bite; my two tails still sway.
You just bumped into me.
I gave half a step, quickly.
There's too little room here.
Don't walk pressed right up against me.

lines.zh: 踩到我的尾巴了，让一让。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; give me room.
You stepped on my shoelace.
I squeezed past you.
That made a loud noise.
You're not much taller than me.
Do not shove; my back is already to the wall.
I need to find the exit first.
I still have things to finish.
You and I aren't the same.
I don't want to discuss it.
I've seen too many people leave.
Save that for later.
I turn away without answering.

lines.zh: 这种地方，不适合说这些。
lines.en: This is no place to talk about such things.
I can't give you an answer.
I stepped back into the shadow.
Picked it up for a look, then set it down.
This has someone else's scent.
I slip it back into my pocket.
This one's useful to me.
This is too heavy. I'm leaving it.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴的我，提不动这个。
lines.en: With two tails, I cannot lift this.
There's blood on this.
I recognize this thing.
Here, take this back.

lines.zh: 太重了，我把它丢在地上。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drop it on the floor.
Someone moved over there.
I heard that noise.
I marked it at first sight.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴一摆，我绕到侧翼。
lines.en: My two tails flick and I flank around.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一步就能扑到。
lines.en: At this distance one step is enough to lunge.
You stay right in this spot.
You stay in this spot.

lines.zh: 长廊没有岔路，只能向前。
lines.en: The long hall has no branch; only forward.

lines.zh: 我的手从口袋里出来了。
lines.en: My hands came out of my pockets.
I crouch, ready to run.
I'll cut off its retreat first.
I won't hesitate this time.
It has its back to me now.
I've already counted to three.
I'll be there in a moment.
That sound is getting closer.
That thing's still in place.
I pulled my cap lower.
I move around behind the door.
Its footsteps are heavy.

lines.zh: 双尾的影子，站在你面前。
lines.en: A two-tailed shadow stands before you.
The echoes here help me.
It's starting to come this way.
I tuck my two tails in.
It stopped and looked.
I hold still against the wall.
It has only one way back.

lines.zh: 再挪一步，我就能抓住它。
lines.en: One more step and I can grab it.
My palm is all sweat against the wall.
It hasn't turned around.
I wait for it to lower its weapon.
This moment will be very short.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴，套在玩家身上。
lines.en: Two tails, worn on a player's frame.
It took one step forward.
I've picked where to land.
Only the last step remains.
I ram it side-on and shove it away.
This kick lands on the knee.
I grab its collar.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴一摆，我就能悬停。
lines.en: Two tails spin and I hover.
It backed off two or three steps.
I kicked off the wall.
That one didn't land solid.
I pulled away at once.

lines.zh: 它的武器划到了我的帽。
lines.en: Its weapon caught my cap.

lines.zh: 我借墙蹬了一下，撞上去。
lines.en: I kicked off the wall and slammed in.
You're beside me. Move.
It went down in the corridor.
I reset my stance.
That used all my force.
It flips over the railing and runs into the dark.
My heel dug into the floor.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴拖着，从暗处过来。
lines.en: Two tails trail behind me out of the dark.
The corridor lights are dim.
Cap pulled low, I hide behind the door.
Old marks are still here.
My two tails sway slowly.
First I listen to the surroundings.
There's a claw mark on the floor.
Fresh claw marks on the wall.
I'm not sure where this is.

lines.zh: 我这两条尾巴，走路时会摆。
lines.en: Both my tails sway as I walk.
I'm looking for that exit.
The echoes carry far here.
I put my hands back in my pockets.

lines.zh: 脚步声不是我一个人的。
lines.en: Those footsteps aren't only mine.
I stop and hold my breath.
I start moving toward the dark.
I haven't picked a direction.
Something is moving.
I stand with my back to the door.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天花板上什么也没有。
lines.en: I look up; there is nothing on the ceiling.
Fire caught my tails.
I rolled down the stairs.
Water blocked my breathing.
The blast threw me against the wall.
Something grazed my shoulder.
That light whited out my sight.
My ration bag is empty; I wet my teeth.

lines.zh: 雷光让整条走廊都亮了。
lines.en: The flash lit the whole corridor.

lines.zh: 我在坠，尾巴抓不住东西。
lines.en: I'm falling, and my tails grip nothing.
